test_title: PYST 61: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the given number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the number-pair in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given number-pairs. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(19, 200)

(15, 160)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number + 1) × 10 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 19 : 200

⇒ (19 + 1) × 10 = 20 × 10 = 200.

For, 15 : 160

⇒ (15 + 1) × 10 = 16 × 10 = 160.

Similarly, for **(22, 230)**

**⇒ (22 + 1) × 10 = 23 × 10 = 230.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
